item.title: Accora 0.1.10
item.description:
• Skip your own account: when a search result matches the logged-in Zalo UID, record “Bỏ qua — Chính tài khoản này” and continue the campaign instead of stopping at `profileChat`.
  • Recover from an open self profile: close the verified own-account popup left by an earlier attempt before searching again. Unrelated manual profiles remain protected.
  • Account-specific results: self skips apply only to that campaign/account assignment, consume no send quota, and do not mark the contact as your own account globally.
  • Pinned messages: distinguish pinned-message previews from friend-request banners so an unrelated chat banner does not prevent friendship classification.
  • History and monitoring: show a separate self-skip result and retain its reason in local history.

item.title: Accora 0.1.9
item.description:
• Business profiles: open Xem thêm to read gender and birthday when Zalo displays them. Use the current detail layout and close the popup correctly before sending from the chat banner.
  • Friend-request flows: support search results that open a profile first, then Nhắn tin. Recognize the chat's Gửi kết bạn action even when the stranger badge or the profile's friend button is absent. Recheck pending requests and recipient identity before confirmation.
  • Fresh personalization: retain name, gender, birthday and {Salutation} mapping from the newly verified profile. Hidden fields are not inferred from stale imports. Existing message templates remain compatible.
  • Bulk contact deletion: select multiple contacts or all matching results, then use Xóa… or Danh bạ → Xóa liên hệ đã chọn… (⌥⌘⌫). Confirmation defaults to Cancel. Contacts still pending/sending in campaigns are kept, and the result shows how many were removed or protected.
  • History preservation: deleting contacts hides them from the address book while retaining send history and daily quotas. Reimporting a deleted number restores its existing identity and refreshes profile data on the next send.
  • Diagnostics: known ResizeObserver loop notifications remain visible as `PAGE_LAYOUT_WARNING`. Other JavaScript and promise errors remain recorded, including unresolved website errors. Automation logs identify the profile/chat route taken.

item.title: Accora 0.1.8
item.description:
• System log monitor: open Nhật ký → Nhật ký hệ thống to search, filter, inspect, copy and export diagnostics stored on this Mac. Logs cover app startup, storage, WebKit and campaign execution, with session and operation references. Files rotate at approximately 200 MiB total; secrets are redacted. The table shows the latest 200 matching events while search and export use up to 5,000 recent events.
  • Contact profile columns: Contacts now displays gender and birthday from synced Zalo profiles. Hidden fields stay empty instead of reverting to old imported values.
  • Personalized greetings: insert {Salutation} in campaign or default messages. A freshly read male Zalo profile maps to anh, female to chị, and hidden or unrecognized gender to bạn. Files without gender still import normally. Existing message templates are kept.
  • Safer manual messaging during campaigns: the running account's Zalo view is locked while automation owns it. Tạm dừng để nhắn tin waits for the current operation to hand control back; resuming searches for the recipient and reads their profile again. Other accounts remain usable.
  • Pause and Stop guard the send confirmation: revocable execution permissions are checked before sending. An uncertain result after confirmation is reconciled without automatically sending another invitation.
  • Background execution improvements: stable parking slots, visibility checks, optional WebKit scheduling fallbacks and separate sleep/lock handling improve session control.
  • Editing and performance fixes: message editors preserve text and cursor state while previews update. Filtering stored logs avoids rebuilding thousands of native table rows.

item.title: Accora 0.1.7
item.description:
• Campaigns run in the background: after starting a campaign you can open History, Contacts, Settings or another account, or switch to a different app. Sending continues. Previously sending stopped with "Trang Zalo bị ẩn" or "recipientChanged" unless the account's Zalo page stayed on screen.
  • Safer when the page is hidden: if the Zalo page is hidden for a moment, Accora moves it back to its background window and retries. When that happens during sending, it re-reads the chat status on Zalo first, so a request is never sent twice.
  • Recipient checks stay reliable in the background: the hidden Zalo page keeps the normal desktop layout, so verifying the recipient's Zalo profile works the same as on screen.
  • Includes random friend messages, synced Zalo recipient profiles and Zalo account profiles from the previous changes.

item.title: Accora 0.1.6
item.description:
• In-app updates: the "new version" banner and Settings → Update now offer Cập nhật ngay, and Accora → Kiểm tra cập nhật… checks directly. Accora downloads the update, verifies its signature, installs it over the current app and relaunches. No GitHub download, no Gatekeeper "Open Anyway" and no permission prompts on later updates.
  • Stable signing: releases are now signed with a fixed Accora certificate instead of a per-build ad-hoc signature, so macOS keeps the permissions you granted across updates.
  • Safer database updates: before a new version changes the local database, Accora saves a copy as `accora-backup-before-<change>.sqlite` next to `accora.sqlite`.
  • Accounts, Zalo sessions, contacts, campaigns, history and settings are kept when updating.
